ops.title: Consumer review found native close ownership leak
ops.body:
Independent review of the cc-present, cc-review, and cc-orchestrate Codex consumer ports found one high-severity correctness regression in cc-review. The terminal close path calls the generic subject-store detach, which clears only legacy session and PID fields; the native subject_owners row remains attached. A later start from the same Codex thread and repo therefore resolves and reopens the supposedly closed review with its old ID and history.

Fix by making terminal detach ownership-aware and transactional in cc-interact or by adding and using an owned-detach path from cc-review. Add native close-then-start coverage asserting a new review ID and no owned-subject result, including the REST close path. Detailed evidence and validation are in /tmp/codex-port-review-consumers.txt.

All three current Go suites passed with the local GOWORK overrides. Live Codex acceptance and the separate native manifest loader probe remain coordinator gates.
